question: What was the breakdown of India's medals in the Special Olympics World Winter Games 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**8 gold, 18 silver, 7 bronze**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Special Olympics World Winter Games** is an international competition held for athletes with intellectual disabilities.
 
• India achieved a remarkable milestone in the **2025 edition** of these games by securing **8 gold, 18 silver, and 7 bronze medals**.
 
• This achievement reflects the growing participation and success of Indian athletes in the field of **sports for differently-abled individuals**.
 
• These medals were won in various disciplines such as **snowboarding, figure skating, alpine skiing, and other winter sports.**
 
• The performance of the athletes highlights their dedication and the efforts of organizations like the **Special Olympics Bharat** in preparing them for international events.
 
• This achievement also emphasizes the importance of providing **inclusive platforms** for individuals with intellectual disabilities to showcase their talents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Special Olympics Bharat** is the Indian chapter of the Special Olympics, founded to provide year-round sports training and athletic competition for children and adults with intellectual disabilities.
 
• The **Special Olympics** is different from the Paralympics. While Paralympics focus on physical disabilities, the Special Olympics caters to athletes with intellectual challenges.
 
• The **World Winter Games** are held every four years and feature sports such as alpine skiing, snowboarding, snowshoeing, and figure skating.
 
• This event provides an opportunity to promote **unity, inclusion, and dignity** for individuals with intellectual disabilities globally.
